name: Funding-gated momentum (long-only spot, crowding filter)
rationale: Medium-term momentum persists, but chasing it when perp funding is already extreme buys into a crowded, over-levered long that is prone to unwind. Use funding as a long FILTER (spot, long-only): take momentum entries only while funding sits BELOW a fitted ceiling (uncrowded), and require a moving-average trend to align. This is funding-as-crowding-signal (NOT a carry to harvest — funding_feature is null, no carry accrual); the ceiling is fit from realized funding so it actually excludes crowded bars. Realized Binance funding clamps at the +1e-4 cap (p90=1e-4, p99=2.9e-4); the fitted ceiling [-2e-5, 1.0e-4] straddles the median up to the cap so the filter genuinely bites instead of sitting above realized max (the degeneracy the carry verdict flagged). No magic numbers.
